description: MultisigProxy.executeProposal(bytes32,bytes).currentTarget (src/MultisigProxy.sol#1159) is a local variable never initialized
review_reason: Intentional zero sentinel for local or explicit-target governance operations; bound operations resolve and validate their target before dispatch.
The price check intentionally consumes answer and updatedAt; it checks positive price, heartbeat freshness, configured price bounds and sequencer status. answeredInRound is deprecated by Chainlink.
Outbound releases collect token commission only. The bridge checks tokenCommission plus netAmount equals the gross release; no native payout is made.
The sequencer check intentionally consumes answer and startedAt; it checks initialization, future timestamps, up status and the recovery grace period.
The nominal net amount is intentionally discarded; the bridge derives its credited net from the measured token receipt minus token commission.
